headings.title: Prerequisites for filing with secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Requires documents to satisfy statutory criteria to be entitled to filing by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Statutory authorization for filing required
headings.reviewNote: Restricts filings to documents authorized or required by this chapter.

headings.title: Required and permissible document contents
headings.reviewNote: Mandates required statutory disclosures and permits inclusion of additional information.

headings.title: Typewritten or printed form requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires all delivered documents to be typewritten or printed.

headings.title: English language and translation requirements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates English language usage, with exceptions for names and foreign certificates accompanied by translations.

headings.title: Authorized execution of corporate documents
headings.reviewNote: Specifies corporate officers, incorporators, or court-appointed fiduciaries authorized to execute documents.

headings.title: Signature, name, and capacity disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Requires signers to state names and capacities and permits seals, attestations, and acknowledgments.

headings.title: Mandatory use of prescribed forms
headings.reviewNote: Requires use of prescribed mandatory forms when established by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Delivery, copies, and filing fee requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivery of documents with conformed copies, statutory filing fees, and any applicable penalties.

headings.title: Truthfulness representation and statutory penalties
headings.reviewNote: Provides that signing a filed document represents belief in its truth subject to section 557.040 penalties; source note records section 577.040 was repealed in 1977.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes general filing requirements for nonprofit corporate documents delivered to the secretary of state.

headings.title: Mandatory forms prescribed by secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes mandatory forms for foreign corporation certificates, withdrawals, and registration reports.

headings.title: Optional forms for other corporate filings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes optional forms for other filings required or permitted under this chapter.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mandatory and permissive corporate document forms prescribed and furnished by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Applicability of chapter and acceptance procedures
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter to domestic nonprofit corporations and establishes procedures for other entities to accept its provisions.

headings.title: Secretary of state certificate and legal effects
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of certificates of acceptance and details legal effects on corporate articles and share conversion.

headings.title: Scope of foreign corporation applicability
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter provisions governing foreign corporations to all foreign nonprofit corporations conducting affairs in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines the scope of the Missouri Nonprofit Corporation Act and prescribes procedures for domestic and foreign entities to accept its provisions.

headings.title: Statutory filing fee schedule
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes the schedule of fees collected by the secretary of state for corporate filings.

headings.title: Service of process fee and recovery
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a service of process fee and permits prevailing parties to recover it as costs.

headings.title: Fees for copying and certifying documents
headings.reviewNote: Sets statutory fees for paper and electronic copying and certifying of filed corporate records.

headings.title: Filing fee waiver for military personnel
headings.reviewNote: Waives initial incorporation and name reservation fees for active duty military and Missouri National Guard members.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes filing fees, service of process charges, copy certification costs, and military fee waivers.

headings.title: Effective date upon filing or endorsement
headings.reviewNote: Sets document effective dates upon filing endorsement or on specified dates following filing.

headings.title: Delayed effective date limits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes specifying a delayed effective date not to exceed ninety days after filing.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs effective dates and delayed effective date limitations for corporate documents filed with the secretary of state.

headings.title: Grounds for correcting filed documents
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corrections for documents containing incorrect statements or defective executions.

headings.title: Preparation and delivery of articles of correction
headings.reviewNote: Specifies contents and filing procedures for articles of correction.

headings.title: Effective date of articles of correction
headings.reviewNote: Establishes retroactive effective dates for corrections except as to adversely affected relying parties.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures, contents, and effective dates for filing articles of correction for defective documents.

headings.title: Duty of secretary of state to file
headings.reviewNote: Mandates filing of documents that satisfy statutory requirements.

headings.title: Endorsement and delivery of filed copies
headings.reviewNote: Requires file-stamping, endorsement, and return of conformed copies or receipts to corporations.

headings.title: Refusal to file and written explanation
headings.reviewNote: Requires return of refused documents within ten days accompanied by written explanations.

headings.title: Ministerial nature of filing duty
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that filing duties are ministerial and create no presumption of document validity or correctness.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines the ministerial duty of the secretary of state to file or refuse corporate documents and deliver conformed copies.

headings.title: Application for certificate of existence
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any person to apply for a certificate of existence for a corporation.

headings.title: Contents of certificate of existence
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required statutory disclosures in certificates of existence and good standing.

headings.title: Conclusive evidence of corporate good standing
headings.reviewNote: Establishes certificates of existence as conclusive evidence of corporate good standing.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs applications, statutory contents, and conclusive evidentiary effect of certificates of existence.

headings.title: Knowingly signing false documents prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits knowingly signing false documents with intent that they be delivered for filing.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor penalty
headings.reviewNote: Classifies the offense of signing false corporate documents as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits knowingly signing false corporate documents for filing and classifies violations as class A misdemeanors.

headings.title: Oral or written notice authorized
headings.reviewNote: Permits notice under this chapter to be communicated orally or in writing.

headings.title: Permissible methods of communicating notice
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes personal, telephonic, wireless, mail, carrier, newspaper, and broadcast methods of notice.

headings.title: Effective date of oral notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides that oral notice is effective when communicated in a comprehensible manner.

headings.title: Effective dates for written notice
headings.reviewNote: Establishes effective dates for written notice based on receipt, postmarks, and mailing class.

headings.title: Correct address for notice to members
headings.reviewNote: Defines correct addressing for written notices sent to corporate members.

headings.title: Notice delivered in corporate publications
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes notice delivered through regularly published member newsletters or magazines.

headings.title: Correct address for notice to corporations
headings.reviewNote: Specifies addressing requirements for written notices directed to domestic or foreign corporations.

headings.title: Controlling specific notice provisions and validity
headings.reviewNote: Provides that specific statutory or bylaw notice provisions control and that procedural failure does not invalidate notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs permissible methods, effective dates, addressing standards, and publication delivery of corporate notices.

headings.title: Tax distribution and activity restrictions for private foundations
headings.reviewNote: Requires private foundations to distribute income to avoid IRC section 4942 tax and prohibits self-dealing, excess business holdings, and IRC sections 4944 and 4945(d) taxable expenditures.

headings.title: Internal Revenue Code references
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory references to corresponding provisions of the federal Internal Revenue Code.

entries.reviewSummary: Imposes mandatory federal tax compliance restrictions on nonprofit corporations operating as private foundations.

headings.title: Petition for court-ordered corporate meeting
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court petitions by directors, members, or the attorney general to order meetings.

headings.title: Notice and determination of members
headings.reviewNote: Requires court orders to prescribe reasonable notice and authorizes judicial determination of members or directors.

headings.title: Waiver of quorum and voting requirements
headings.reviewNote: Permits court orders to dispense with statutory or bylaw quorum and voting thresholds.

headings.title: Scope of subject matter authorized
headings.reviewNote: Directs courts to limit meeting agendas to governance continuity or dissolution and merger approvals.

headings.title: Validity and binding effect of ordered meeting
headings.reviewNote: Accords full legal validity to meetings, votes, and ballots conducted under court orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes circuit courts to order meetings, specify notice, and dispense with quorum rules when nonprofit governance is impractical.

headings.title: Notice of proceedings to attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice to the attorney general upon commencement of proceedings authorized to be brought by the state.

headings.title: Attorney general enforcement and intervention rights
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the attorney general to seek injunctive relief or intervene as of right in corporate proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mandatory notice of corporate proceedings to the attorney general and authorizes independent injunctive relief or intervention.

headings.title: Incorporators delivering articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes one or more individuals to act as incorporators by delivering articles to the secretary of state.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates mandatory disclosures including corporate name, public or mutual benefit classification, registered agent, and member status.

headings.title: Permissible provisions in articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes optional provisions regarding lawful corporate purposes, initial directors, and member rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes mandatory and permissive contents of nonprofit articles of incorporation and incorporator delivery procedures.

headings.title: Commencement of corporate existence
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that corporate existence begins upon filing of the articles unless a delayed date is specified.

headings.title: Conclusive proof of incorporation conditions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes secretary of state filing as conclusive proof of compliance with incorporation conditions precedent.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines when corporate existence begins and provides that filed articles serve as conclusive proof of incorporation.

headings.title: Organizational meeting of directors or incorporators
headings.reviewNote: Mandates holding an organizational meeting to appoint officers, adopt bylaws, or elect directors.

headings.title: Action by written consent without meeting
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes incorporators to take organizational action by unanimous written consent without a formal meeting.

headings.title: Location of organizational meetings
headings.reviewNote: Permits holding organizational meetings within or outside the state.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs organizational meetings of initial directors or incorporators, unanimous written consents, and meeting locations.

headings.title: Adoption of emergency bylaws by directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes directors to adopt emergency bylaws establishing special meeting, quorum, and director appointment procedures.

headings.title: Duration and effectiveness of regular bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Maintains regular bylaws consistent with emergency bylaws and terminates emergency rules upon conclusion of emergencies.

headings.title: Binding effect of good faith actions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that corporate actions taken in good faith under emergency bylaws bind the corporation.

headings.title: Definition of catastrophic emergency
headings.reviewNote: Defines an emergency as a catastrophic event preventing the assembly of a director quorum.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes directors to adopt emergency bylaws and establishes governance rules during catastrophic events.

headings.title: Lawful activity purpose of corporation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that nonprofit corporations have the purpose of engaging in any lawful activity unless restricted in articles.

headings.title: Compliance with other regulatory statutes
headings.reviewNote: Conditions incorporation for regulated activities on compliance with and non-prohibition by applicable statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines the broad lawful activity purpose of nonprofit corporations and coordinates with specialized regulatory statutes.

headings.title: Emergency powers of board of directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards to modify lines of succession and relocate offices in anticipation of emergencies.

headings.title: Notice and officer quorum during emergencies
headings.reviewNote: Relaxes meeting notice requirements and allows ranking officers to serve as directors to achieve quorums.

headings.title: Binding effect of emergency actions
headings.reviewNote: Binds corporations to good faith actions taken during emergencies to further ordinary corporate affairs.

headings.title: Catastrophic event emergency standard
headings.reviewNote: Defines an emergency as a catastrophic event preventing assembly of a director quorum.

entries.reviewSummary: Grants boards of directors emergency powers to modify succession lines, relocate offices, and assemble quorums during catastrophes.

headings.title: General limitation on ultra vires challenges
headings.reviewNote: Precludes challenging corporate actions on the ground that the corporation lacked power to act.

headings.title: Proceedings to enjoin unauthorized acts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes injunction proceedings by the attorney general, directors, or members before third-party rights attach.

headings.title: Proceedings against directors or agents
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes actions against current or former directors and agents for unauthorized corporate acts.

entries.reviewSummary: Limits ultra vires challenges to corporate action while preserving specified injunction proceedings and proceedings against incumbent or former corporate officials.

headings.title: Purpose limitations on corporate name
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits corporate names stating or implying purposes not authorized by statute or articles.

headings.title: Distinguishability of corporate name on records
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate names to be distinguishable from registered entity names upon state records.

headings.title: Permissible use of another corporate name
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes using another corporate name upon merger, reorganization, or asset acquisition.

headings.title: Fictitious names not controlled by chapter
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that chapter provisions do not regulate the use of fictitious names.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs corporate name distinguishability standards, purpose limitations, merger exceptions, and fictitious names.

headings.title: Application and duration of name reservation
headings.reviewNote: Provides for sixty-day corporate name reservations up to a maximum duration of one hundred eighty days.

headings.title: Transfer of reserved corporate name
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transfer of reserved corporate names by delivering signed notices of transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates procedures, durations, and transfers for corporate name reservations filed with the secretary of state.

headings.title: Corporation statement of change of office
headings.reviewNote: Specifies contents of statements delivered by corporations to change registered offices or agents.

headings.title: Agent statement of change of office
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered agents to change registered office addresses across represented corporations upon written notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs corporate and agent statements of change for registered offices and registered agents.

headings.title: Registered agent as service agent
headings.reviewNote: Designates registered agents as corporate agents for service of process, notice, or demand.

headings.title: Substituted service by mail upon secretary
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service by registered or certified mail to corporate secretaries when agents cannot be found.

headings.title: Other lawful service methods preserved
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory service rules do not prescribe the exclusive means of serving corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes registered agent service of process procedures, substituted mail service, and nonexclusive remedies.

headings.title: Admission of members and consent requirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bylaw admission criteria and prohibits admitting members without their consent.

headings.title: No mandatory requirement for members
headings.reviewNote: Provides that nonprofit corporations are not required to have members.

headings.title: Consideration for member admission
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes member admission for no consideration or for consideration determined by boards.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs member admission criteria, consent requirements, consideration, and optional member structures.

headings.title: Transfer restrictions for mutual benefit corporations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transferring mutual benefit memberships unless authorized by articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Transfer prohibition for public benefit corporations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits members of public benefit corporations from transferring memberships or membership rights.

headings.title: Restrictions inapplicable to existing members
headings.reviewNote: Restricts application of newly adopted transfer limitations against preexisting members without consent.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts transferability of nonprofit memberships in mutual and public benefit corporations and protects preexisting rights.

headings.title: Member immunity from corporate liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Shields members from personal liability for corporate acts, debts, liabilities, or obligations.

headings.title: Liability for dues, assessments, and fees
headings.reviewNote: Permits member liability for dues while clarifying that authorizing resolutions alone do not create liability.

headings.title: Preservation of real property assessments
headings.reviewNote: Preserves personal liability for covenants, assessments, or charges imposed under recorded real property indentures.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes member immunity from corporate debts while preserving dues liabilities and real property covenants.

headings.title: Prerequisites for creditor actions against members
headings.reviewNote: Requires unsatisfied final judgments against corporations before creditors may bring proceedings against members.

headings.title: Creditor intervention and joinder of members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes creditor intervention and joinder of all members owing debts to corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedural prerequisites, judgment execution requirements, and joinder rules for creditor actions against members.

headings.title: Fair and reasonable expulsion procedure requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires fair, reasonable, good-faith procedures to expel, suspend, or terminate members (excluding churches or church associations), clarifying amenity suspensions are not member suspensions.

headings.title: Standards for fair and reasonable procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes minimum notice and hearing standards constituting fair and reasonable expulsion procedures.

headings.title: Mailing requirements for expulsion notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires written expulsion notices to be delivered by first class or certified mail to member addresses.

headings.title: Statute of limitations for challenging expulsion
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a one-year statute of limitations on actions challenging member expulsions, suspensions, or terminations.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates procedures, notice standards, hearing opportunities, and limitation periods for member expulsions or terminations.

headings.title: Prohibition on public benefit membership purchases
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits public benefit corporations from purchasing memberships or rights arising therefrom.

headings.title: Authorized purchase by mutual benefit corporations
headings.reviewNote: Permits mutual benefit corporations to purchase memberships of resigning or terminated members under articles or bylaws, provided no payment violates section 355.661.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits membership repurchases by public benefit corporations and governs permissible purchases by mutual benefit corporations.

headings.title: Standing to bring derivative proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members holding ten percent voting power, fifty members, or directors to bring derivative suits.

headings.title: Complainant status at suit commencement
headings.reviewNote: Requires complainants to maintain member or director status at the time proceedings are filed.

headings.title: Verified complaint and demand allegations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates verified complaints detailing demand on directors and authorizes judicial stays during investigations.

headings.title: Defendant expense award for frivolous suits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to assess defendant counsel fees against complainants bringing frivolous or bad faith suits.

headings.title: Complainant expense award upon success
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes expense and counsel fee awards to successful complainants in derivative actions.

headings.title: Notice to attorney general for public benefit
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice to the attorney general within ten days for public benefit or charitable trust suits.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs member and director derivative proceedings, verified complaint demands, fee awards, and attorney general notices.

headings.title: Authorization for corporate delegates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes articles or bylaws to provide for delegates exercising member powers.

headings.title: Bylaw provisions governing delegates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rules regarding delegate qualifications, selection, removal, and meetings.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes the appointment of corporate delegates and regulates delegate powers, selection, and meeting procedures.

headings.title: Annual meeting requirement for membership corporations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual meetings for corporations with members at times fixed in bylaws.

headings.title: Regular membership meetings authorized
headings.reviewNote: Permits corporations with members to hold regular meetings as fixed in bylaws.

headings.title: Location of membership meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes holding membership meetings within or outside the state or at principal offices.

headings.title: Required reports and business at annual meetings
headings.reviewNote: Mandates president and financial officer reports and member consideration of business.

headings.title: Member action at regular meetings
headings.reviewNote: Governs member consideration of business at regular meetings consistent with notice rules.

headings.title: Validity of corporate action unaffected by omission
headings.reviewNote: Provides that failure to hold annual or regular meetings does not impair corporate action validity.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs annual and regular membership meetings, officer reporting duties, meeting locations, and corporate validity.

headings.title: Special meetings called by board or members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes special meetings upon call of the board or demand of five percent voting power.

headings.title: Record date for member meeting demand
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the record date as thirty days before delivery of member meeting demands.

headings.title: Notice given by demanding members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes demanding members to set meeting times and give notice if corporate officers fail to act.

headings.title: Location of special membership meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes holding special meetings within or outside the state or at principal offices.

headings.title: Business limited to noticed purposes
headings.reviewNote: Restricts business conducted at special meetings strictly to purposes described in meeting notices.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes rules for calling special membership meetings, member demand thresholds, notice defaults, and agenda limits.

headings.title: Circuit court order for membership meeting
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit courts to order annual, regular, or special meetings upon application.

headings.title: Court orders regulating meeting procedures
headings.reviewNote: Empowers courts to fix meeting times, record dates, notice forms, and quorum rules.

headings.title: Award of member costs and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to order corporations to pay member costs and counsel fees incurred to obtain orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes circuit courts to order membership meetings, prescribe procedures, and assess member legal fees.

headings.title: Member action by written consent threshold
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes member action without meetings upon written consent of eighty percent voting power.

headings.title: Record date for action by consent
headings.reviewNote: Sets the record date for consent actions as the date the first member signs the consent.

headings.title: Legal effect of written member consent
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that signed written consents have the full legal effect of meeting votes.

headings.title: Notice to nonconsenting members and effective date
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to nonconsenting members and delays effectiveness until ten days after notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs member action by written consent without a meeting, voting thresholds, record dates, and notice requirements.

headings.title: Fair and reasonable meeting notice requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to give notice of member meetings in a fair and reasonable manner.

headings.title: Safe harbor standards for fair notice
headings.reviewNote: Establishes statutory notice criteria that constitute fair and reasonable notice.

headings.title: Notice timing, content, and extraordinary matters
headings.reviewNote: Specifies ten to sixty days' notice (thirty to sixty days if not first-class or registered mail) and descriptions of specified member-approved or special meeting matters.

headings.title: Notice requirements for adjourned meetings
headings.reviewNote: Governs notice for adjourned meetings and requires new notice if new record dates are fixed.

headings.title: Member requests to include agenda items
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice of member proposals upon timely written request by persons entitled to call meetings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes timing, content, adjournment, and agenda inclusion rules for fair and reasonable notice of member meetings.

headings.title: Written waiver of notice by members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes written waivers of notice signed by members before or after meeting dates.

headings.title: Waiver of notice objections by attendance
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that meeting attendance waives notice and agenda objections unless timely raised.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs written waivers of meeting notice and waiver of objections through member attendance.

headings.title: Record date for meeting notice
headings.reviewNote: Governs fixing of record dates to determine members entitled to notice of meetings.

headings.title: Record date for voting at meetings
headings.reviewNote: Governs fixing of record dates to determine members entitled to vote at meetings.

headings.title: Record date for other member actions
headings.reviewNote: Governs record dates for determining members entitled to exercise other lawful member rights.

headings.title: Maximum time limit for record date
headings.reviewNote: Limits record dates to no more than seventy days prior to meetings or member actions.

headings.title: Record date effectiveness for adjourned meetings
headings.reviewNote: Applies original record dates to adjourned meetings unless adjourned beyond seventy days.

headings.title: Court-ordered adjournment record date rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts adjourning meetings beyond one hundred twenty days to fix new record dates.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates determination and maximum time limits of record dates for member notice, voting, and adjourned meetings.

headings.title: Action by written ballot authorized
headings.reviewNote: Permits member action without a meeting through delivery of written ballots to all voting members.

headings.title: Form and contents of written ballot
headings.reviewNote: Requires written ballots to state proposed actions and afford opportunities to vote for or against.

headings.title: Quorum and approval thresholds for ballots
headings.reviewNote: Requires ballot responses and approvals to meet or exceed regular meeting voting requirements.

headings.title: Mandatory solicitation disclosures on ballots
headings.reviewNote: Requires written ballot solicitations to state quorum response counts, approval percentages for non-director matters, and receipt deadlines.

headings.title: Irrevocability of cast written ballots
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that written ballots may not be revoked unless authorized by articles or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes and regulates member voting by written ballot without a meeting, setting quorum, disclosure, and irrevocability standards.

headings.title: Alphabetical voting list preparation requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to prepare an alphabetical list of voting members showing addresses and votes.

headings.title: Inspection of member list before meeting
headings.reviewNote: Makes member lists available for inspection two business days after notice at principal offices.

headings.title: Availability of member list at meeting
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to make member lists available for inspection throughout meetings.

headings.title: Court-ordered inspection and meeting postponement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes summary court orders for inspection, meeting postponements, and member fee awards.

headings.title: Validity of meeting actions despite noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Provides that refusal or failure to comply with list requirements does not affect meeting action validity unless a prior written demand was improperly refused.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs preparation, inspection, judicial enforcement, and meeting validity regarding corporate membership voting lists.

headings.title: Default one vote per member rule
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a default rule that each member is entitled to one vote on each matter.

headings.title: Voting rules for multiple record holders
headings.reviewNote: Governs binding effect when one coholder votes and pro rata division when multiple coholders vote.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes default voting rights of members and rules governing memberships held by multiple persons.

headings.title: Default ten percent quorum requirement
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a ten percent voting power quorum requirement unless otherwise provided in articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Approval of quorum decreases
headings.reviewNote: Permits members or boards to approve bylaw amendments decreasing quorum requirements.

headings.title: Member approval required for quorum increases
headings.reviewNote: Mandates member approval for bylaw amendments increasing required quorum thresholds.

headings.title: Matter restrictions absent one-third attendance
headings.reviewNote: Restricts votes to noticed matters unless one-third or more voting power is represented.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes member quorum standards, amendment voting rules, and restrictions on unannounced meeting business.

headings.title: Majority vote of quorum required
headings.reviewNote: Provides that affirmative votes representing a majority of the required quorum constitute member acts.

headings.title: Member approval for voting threshold amendments
headings.reviewNote: Requires member approval for bylaw amendments changing member voting thresholds.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines member voting approval standards and requires member consent to alter voting threshold bylaws.

headings.title: Appointment of proxy by member
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members to appoint proxies to vote by signing appointment forms personally or by attorney-in-fact.

headings.title: Effective date and duration of proxy
headings.reviewNote: Sets eleven-month default validity and three-year maximum duration for proxy appointments.

headings.title: Revocability of proxy appointments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that proxy appointments are revocable by members.

headings.title: Effect of member death or incapacity
headings.reviewNote: Maintains corporate authority to accept a proxy after member death or incapacity unless notice is received by the vote-tabulating officer or agent before exercise.

headings.title: Revocation of proxy by attendance or writing
headings.reviewNote: Provides for proxy revocation by attending meetings and voting or delivering written revocations.

headings.title: Corporate acceptance of proxy actions
headings.reviewNote: Entitles corporations to accept proxy votes as acts of appointing members subject to limitations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs appointment, duration, revocability, corporate acceptance, and termination of member proxies.

headings.title: Cumulative voting method for directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cumulative voting for directors by multiplying votes by the number of open director seats.

headings.title: Notice prerequisites for cumulative voting
headings.reviewNote: Requires meeting notice or advance member notice at meetings before cumulative voting is authorized.

headings.title: Removal restrictions for cumulative directors
headings.reviewNote: Restricts member removal of cumulatively elected directors without cause.

headings.title: Prohibition when directors and members identical
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits cumulative voting when the directors and members of a corporation are identical.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates cumulative voting procedures for director elections, meeting notice rules, and removal protections.

headings.title: Acceptance of corresponding member signatures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporations to accept votes, consents, or proxies matching member record names in good faith.

headings.title: Acceptance of non-corresponding or fiduciary signatures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes accepting signatures by corporate officers, attorneys-in-fact, co-tenants, and court fiduciaries.

headings.title: Rejection of doubtful signatures authorized
headings.reviewNote: Entitles corporations to reject votes or proxies if reasonable doubt exists regarding signature validity.

headings.title: Immunity for good faith acceptance or rejection
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes corporations and officers from damage liability for good faith acceptance or rejection of votes.

headings.title: Validity of corporate actions upon vote acceptance
headings.reviewNote: Establishes validity of corporate actions based on accepted or rejected votes absent court rulings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes standards, fiduciary verification rules, and liability immunity for corporate acceptance or rejection of member votes.

headings.title: Board of directors requirement and naming
headings.reviewNote: Requires each corporation to have a board of directors, trustees, regents, or overseers.

headings.title: Exercise of corporate powers by board
headings.reviewNote: Directs that all corporate powers be exercised by or under the authority and direction of boards.

headings.title: Board of curators designation authorized
headings.reviewNote: Permits nonprofit corporations formed prior to August 28, 1997, to use the name board of curators.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates corporate boards of directors, defines management authority, and authorizes alternative board designations.

headings.title: Natural person requirement and other qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires directors to be natural persons and permits articles or bylaws to prescribe qualifications.

headings.title: Minimum of three directors required
headings.reviewNote: Requires boards of directors to consist of three or more persons as fixed in articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Modification of number of directors
headings.reviewNote: Permits increasing or decreasing the number of directors to no fewer than three by articles or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs director qualifications, board size minimums of three directors, and procedures to alter board numbers.

headings.title: Director election in membership corporations
headings.reviewNote: Governs annual election, appointment, or designation of directors in corporations with members.

headings.title: Director election in nonmembership corporations
headings.reviewNote: Provides for election of directors by boards in corporations without members absent other bylaw methods.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates election, appointment, and designation of directors in membership and nonmembership corporations.

headings.title: Specification of director terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires articles or bylaws to specify terms of up to six years, with a one-year default.

headings.title: Protection of incumbent director terms
headings.reviewNote: Provides that decreases in director numbers or term lengths do not shorten incumbent terms.

headings.title: Term expiration for vacancy appointments
headings.reviewNote: Governs term expiration for directors appointed to fill member or board vacancies.

headings.title: Holding over until successor qualifies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes incumbent directors to continue serving beyond term expiration until successors qualify.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs terms of directors, term limits, vacancy term durations, and continuation until successor qualification.

headings.title: Written notice of director resignation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director resignation at any time by delivering written notice to corporate officers.

headings.title: Effective date and pending vacancy filling
headings.reviewNote: Provides that resignations are effective upon delivery or specified future dates and permits advance replacement.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates written notice procedures, effective dates, and advance filling of director resignations.

headings.title: Removal of elected directors by members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members to remove one or more directors elected by them without cause.

headings.title: Removal by specific voting class or unit
headings.reviewNote: Requires directors elected by specific classes or geographic units to be removed solely by those units.

headings.title: Vote required for member removal
headings.reviewNote: Requires member removal votes to equal or exceed votes necessary to elect the director.

headings.title: Cumulative voting removal protections
headings.reviewNote: Protects directors from member removal if votes sufficient to elect under cumulative rules oppose removal.

headings.title: Meeting notice requirement for removal
headings.reviewNote: Mandates holding a meeting called for director removal with notice stating the removal purpose.

headings.title: Vote computation for removal protection
headings.reviewNote: Establishes voting computation standards for determining director protection from removal.

headings.title: Removal of entire board authorized
headings.reviewNote: Permits removal of an entire board of directors under statutory member removal procedures.

headings.title: Removal of board-elected directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board removal by two-thirds vote of directors elected by boards, subject to member rights.

headings.title: Removal for missed board meetings
headings.reviewNote: Permits majority board removal for failing to attend meeting numbers specified in articles or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs member and board removal of directors without cause, cumulative voting protections, and meeting absence rules.

headings.title: Removal of designated directors by amendment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes removal of designated directors through article or bylaw amendments.

headings.title: Removal of appointed directors by appointing authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing persons to remove appointed directors without cause upon written notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates removal of designated directors by governing document amendment and appointed directors by appointing authorities.

headings.title: Judicial proceeding to remove director for misconduct
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit courts to remove directors for fraud, dishonesty, or gross abuse of authority.

headings.title: Judicial bar from serving on board
headings.reviewNote: Empowers courts removing directors to bar them from serving on boards for prescribed periods.

headings.title: Corporation as party defendant in suit
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to be joined as party defendants when members or the attorney general sue.

headings.title: Written notice to attorney general required
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written notice to the attorney general for removal suits in public benefit corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes circuit court proceedings to remove directors for fraud, gross abuse, or fiduciary breaches, with bar orders.

headings.title: Methods for filling board vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members, boards, or remaining directors to fill vacancies resulting from increases or departures.

headings.title: Vacancies in appointed director positions
headings.reviewNote: Restricts filling appointed director vacancies exclusively to the appointing authority.

headings.title: Vacancies in designated director positions
headings.reviewNote: Directs filling of designated director vacancies pursuant to articles or bylaws and precludes board filling.

headings.title: Advance filling of prospective vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Permits filling a future vacancy before it occurs, provided the new director may not take office until the vacancy occurs.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs procedures and voting authorities for filling vacancies among elected, appointed, and designated directors.

headings.title: Regular and special directors meetings defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines regular meetings as those fixed in bylaws or held at regular intervals, and others as special.

headings.title: Location of board meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards of directors to hold regular or special meetings within or outside the state.

headings.title: Participation by teleconference or communications equipment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes directors to participate in meetings by simultaneous audio communication equipment.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines regular and special board meetings, meeting locations, and participation by simultaneous electronic communications.

headings.title: Unanimous written consent of directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board action without meetings upon unanimous written consent of all directors.

headings.title: Effective date of unanimous written consent
headings.reviewNote: Establishes effective date when the last director signs unless consents specify different dates.

headings.title: Legal effect of written consent
headings.reviewNote: Accords signed unanimous consents the full legal effect of meeting votes.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes and governs board of directors action by unanimous written consent without a meeting.

headings.title: Regular board meetings held without notice
headings.reviewNote: Permits regular board meetings to be held without notice unless otherwise provided in articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Two days notice for special meetings
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least two days advance notice of date, time, place, and purpose for special board meetings.

headings.title: Authority to call board meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes presiding officers, presidents, or twenty percent of directors to call and notice meetings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes notice requirements, timing rules, and call authority for regular and special board meetings.

headings.title: Written waiver of notice by directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes directors to waive meeting notice at any time by delivering signed written waivers.

headings.title: Waiver of notice by meeting attendance
headings.reviewNote: Provides that attendance or participation waives required notice unless the director objects upon arrival or before voting on an improperly noticed matter and does not vote for or assent to it.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs written waivers of meeting notice and waiver of objections through director attendance.

headings.title: Board quorum requirements and minimum limits
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a majority quorum requirement and prohibits quorums below two directors or one-third in office.

headings.title: Majority vote of directors present
headings.reviewNote: Provides that affirmative votes of a majority of directors present constitute board action.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes quorum requirements, statutory minimum limits, and voting rules for board of directors actions.

headings.title: Creation of board committees and appointment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes creation of board committees consisting of two or more directors serving at board pleasure.

headings.title: Director vote required to create committee
headings.reviewNote: Requires committee creation and appointments to be approved by a majority of directors in office.

headings.title: Procedural rules governing committee meetings
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory board meeting, notice, quorum, and voting rules to board committees.

headings.title: Exercise of board authority by committees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes committees to exercise board powers to the extent specified in articles, bylaws, or resolutions.

headings.title: Statutory prohibitions on committee authority
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits committees from authorizing distributions (except for value received), approving or recommending dissolution, merger, or major asset transfers, electing or removing directors (unless articles or bylaws state otherwise), or amending articles or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs creation, appointment, procedure, delegated authority, and statutory power limitations of board committees.

headings.title: Conflict of interest transaction definition
headings.reviewNote: Defines conflict of interest transactions and protects noncompensated directors when transactions are fair or approved.

headings.title: Approval in public benefit or religious corporations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes advance board approval or attorney general or court approval for noncompensated director conflicts.

headings.title: Approval in mutual benefit corporations
headings.reviewNote: Permits mutual benefit director conflicts to be authorized by disinterested directors or voting members.

headings.title: Quorum and voting by disinterested directors
headings.reviewNote: Provides that majority vote of disinterested directors authorizes conflict transactions and constitutes a quorum.

headings.title: Member voting on conflict transactions
headings.reviewNote: Excludes interested director votes and establishes member quorum and approval standards for conflict transactions.

headings.title: Additional governance requirements permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes articles, bylaws, or board resolutions to impose additional restrictions on conflict transactions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs definitions, approval mechanisms, disinterested director voting, and member authorization for conflict of interest transactions.

headings.title: Director liability for unlawful distributions
headings.reviewNote: Imposes personal liability on directors voting for or assenting to unlawful corporate distributions.

headings.title: Contribution rights from directors and recipients
headings.reviewNote: Provides contribution rights against assenting directors and recipients of unlawful distributions.

headings.title: Good faith reliance on professional reports
headings.reviewNote: Entitles directors to rely on officers, legal counsel, accountants, and religious authorities.

headings.title: Bad faith knowledge precluding reliance
headings.reviewNote: Precludes good faith reliance when directors possess knowledge making reliance unwarranted.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes director liability for unlawful distributions, contribution remedies, and good faith reliance protections.

headings.title: Required corporate officers and election
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to have a chairman or president, secretary, treasurer, and authorizes member election.

headings.title: Delegation of minute-taking and record authentication
headings.reviewNote: Mandates delegating responsibility for meeting minutes and record authentication to a designated officer.

headings.title: Simultaneous holding of multiple offices
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the same individual to hold simultaneously more than one corporate office.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs required corporate officers, minute preparation duties, and simultaneous holding of multiple offices.

headings.title: Resignation of officers and vacancy filling
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes officer resignations and permits advance filling of pending prospective vacancies.

headings.reviewNote: Empowers boards of directors to remove any officer at any time with or without cause.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates officer resignations, effective dates, advance replacements, and removal without cause by boards.

headings.title: Appointment not creating contract rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that appointment of an officer does not of itself create contractual rights.

headings.title: Preservation of existing contract rights
headings.reviewNote: Provides that officer removal or resignation does not impair preexisting contract rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the effect of officer appointment, removal, and resignation upon corporate and officer contract rights.

headings.title: Indemnification in third-party proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes indemnification of directors, officers, employees, and agents in third-party proceedings.

headings.title: Indemnification in corporate derivative suits
headings.reviewNote: Permits expense indemnification in derivative suits upon good faith, barring indemnity upon adjudged negligence or misconduct unless court-approved; source note records original rolls read 'indemnify'.

headings.title: Mandatory indemnification upon successful defense
headings.reviewNote: Mandates indemnification of expenses for corporate agents successful on the merits or in defense.

headings.title: Determination of standard of conduct
headings.reviewNote: Requires case-specific determinations of proper conduct by disinterested directors, independent legal counsel, or shareholders unless court-ordered.

headings.title: Advance payment of defense expenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes advance payment of defense expenses upon receipt of an undertaking to repay.

headings.title: Nonexclusivity of statutory indemnification rights
headings.reviewNote: Preserves nonexclusive indemnification rights under section 537.117, other law, articles, bylaws, agreements, or shareholder or disinterested director votes, continuing for former officials and their heirs.

headings.title: Further indemnity authorized by articles or bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes broader indemnity under articles or shareholder-approved bylaws excluding willful misconduct.

headings.title: Insurance coverage for directors and agents
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes purchasing liability insurance for corporate agents regardless of corporate indemnity power.

headings.title: Application to all domestic corporations
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory indemnification provisions to all existing and new domestic nonprofit corporations.

headings.title: Indemnification rights in merger and consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Extends indemnification protections to constituent corporations absorbed in mergers or consolidations.

headings.title: Employee benefit plans and fiduciaries
headings.reviewNote: Defines other enterprises to include employee benefit plans and defines fiduciary good faith standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive statutory framework for permissive, mandatory, and advanced indemnification and insurance for corporate agents.

headings.title: Consistency requirement for indemnification provisions
headings.reviewNote: Validates indemnification or expense advance provisions only to the extent consistent with statute and articles.

headings.title: Reimbursement of witness expenses permitted
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies authority to reimburse expenses incurred by directors appearing as witnesses.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates statutory consistency requirements for indemnification provisions and preserves witness expense reimbursements.

headings.title: Amendment of articles without member approval
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards to adopt specified administrative amendments to articles without member approval.

headings.title: Amendment procedures in nonmembership corporations
headings.reviewNote: Governs article amendment procedures, meeting notices, and majority director votes in corporations without members.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes specific administrative amendments by boards without member approval and governs amendments in nonmembership corporations.

headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards to condition submission of article amendments on higher voting percentages.

headings.title: Notice of membership meeting for amendments
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice describing proposed article amendments for member consideration at meetings.

headings.title: Material soliciting written consents or ballots
headings.reviewNote: Requires solicitations for written consents or ballots to contain copies or summaries of amendments.

headings.title: Amendment approval for church corporations
headings.reviewNote: Governs article amendment approval by members and designated persons in church corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs approval procedures, member voting thresholds, board conditions, and notice for amending articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Class voting on public benefit articles
headings.reviewNote: Entitles classes in public benefit corporations to vote as a class on amendments altering voting rights.

headings.title: Class voting on mutual benefit articles
headings.reviewNote: Entitles classes in mutual benefit corporations to vote as a class on amendments altering rights or authorizations.

headings.title: Class voting in church corporations
headings.reviewNote: Limits class voting on article amendments in church corporations to provisions authorized in articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Approval by newly created classes
headings.reviewNote: Requires amendments dividing a class into multiple classes to be approved by each resulting class.

headings.title: Vote required for class approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires approval by two-thirds of votes cast or a majority of class voting power.

headings.title: Inherent class voting rights preserved
headings.reviewNote: Preserves statutory class voting rights regardless of contrary article or bylaw voting limitations.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates mandatory class voting on article amendments affecting class rights, privileges, or structural divisions.

headings.title: Board authority to restate articles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards of directors to restate articles of incorporation at any time.

headings.title: Amendments included within restated articles

headings.reviewNote: Requires boards to submit restatements containing amendments to voting members for approval.

headings.title: Notice of meeting to approve restatement
headings.reviewNote: Requires written meeting notice identifying proposed amendments contained within restated articles.

headings.title: Vote required for member approval
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory article amendment voting standards to restatements requiring member approval.

headings.title: Submission for designated person approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires restatements containing amendments to be submitted to persons designated in articles.

headings.title: Permissible omissions from restated articles
headings.reviewNote: Permits restatements to omit initial incorporators, initial directors, and historical stock changes.

headings.title: Delivery of restated articles and certificates
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivery of restated articles and certificates of adoption to the secretary of state.

headings.title: Superseding effect of restated articles
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that duly adopted restated articles supersede original articles and prior amendments.

headings.title: Certification of restated articles by secretary
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the secretary of state to certify restated articles without extraneous certificate data.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs restatement of articles of incorporation, member approval of amendments, permissible omissions, and superseding effect.

headings.title: Judicial reorganization plan article amendments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes article amendments without board or member approval to carry out federal reorganization decrees.

headings.title: Delivery of reorganization articles of amendment
headings.reviewNote: Requires court-designated individuals to deliver articles of amendment reciting federal court jurisdiction.

headings.reviewNote: Terminates reorganization amendment authority after entry of final decrees in federal proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes and regulates corporate article amendments ordered pursuant to federal judicial reorganization decrees.

headings.title: Approval thresholds for bylaw amendments
headings.reviewNote: Requires bylaw amendments to be approved by boards, members by two-thirds vote, and designated persons.

headings.title: Member conditions on bylaw amendments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members to condition bylaw amendment approvals on higher affirmative voting thresholds.

headings.title: Board conditions on bylaw amendments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards to condition bylaw amendment adoption on higher affirmative voting thresholds.

headings.title: Notice of member meeting for bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice describing proposed bylaw amendments for member consideration at meetings.

headings.title: Solicitations for written consents or ballots
headings.reviewNote: Requires solicitations for bylaw approvals by written consent or ballot to include amendment summaries.

headings.title: Bylaw amendment approval in church corporations
headings.reviewNote: Governs bylaw amendment approval by members and designated persons in church corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs approval procedures, voting thresholds, board conditions, and notice requirements for amending corporate bylaws.

headings.title: Class voting on public benefit bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Entitles classes in public benefit corporations to vote as a class on bylaw amendments altering voting rights.

headings.title: Class voting on mutual benefit bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Entitles classes in mutual benefit corporations to vote as a class on bylaw amendments altering rights or authorizations.

headings.title: Class voting in church corporations
headings.reviewNote: Limits class voting on bylaw amendments in church corporations to provisions authorized in articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Approval by newly created bylaw classes
headings.reviewNote: Requires bylaw amendments dividing a class into multiple classes to be approved by each resulting class.

headings.title: Vote required for bylaw class approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires bylaw class approval by two-thirds of votes cast or a majority of class voting power.

headings.title: Inherent class voting rights for bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Preserves statutory class voting rights on bylaw amendments regardless of contrary governing provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates mandatory class voting on bylaw amendments affecting membership rights, preferences, or class divisions.

headings.reviewNote: Requires amendments terminating or canceling all or any class of members to meet statutory rules.

headings.title: Advance notice to mutual benefit members
headings.reviewNote: Requires mutual benefit boards to give advance notice of amendments proposing member termination.

headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of member opposing statements up to five hundred words in proposed amendment notices.

headings.title: Two-thirds class vote required for termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires member termination amendments to be approved by two-thirds of votes cast by each affected class.

headings.reviewNote: Exempts amendments satisfying this section from general fair expulsion hearing requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs article and bylaw amendments terminating membership classes, requiring opposing statements, and setting class vote thresholds.

headings.title: Permissible provisions in plan of merger
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes optional plan provisions regarding surviving articles, bylaws, and related merger terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes mergers of nonprofit corporations into business or nonprofit entities and prescribes plan of merger contents.

headings.title: Merger approval in nonmembership corporations

headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice describing merger plans and providing summaries of surviving articles and bylaws.

headings.title: Material soliciting consent or ballot on merger
headings.reviewNote: Requires merger solicitations by written consent or ballot to include plan summaries and governing documents.

headings.title: Class voting on plan of merger
headings.reviewNote: Mandates class voting on merger plans containing provisions that would entitle classes to vote on amendments.

headings.title: Abandonment of merger before filing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes abandonment of planned mergers before articles are filed without further member action.

headings.title: Publication notice for residential facility corporations
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days newspaper publication and facility posting before residential facility nonprofits alter purposes.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs adoption, member voting, class approvals, abandonment, and residential facility notice for plans of merger.

headings.title: Delivery and contents of articles of merger
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required statements and voting disclosures in articles of merger delivered to the secretary of state.

headings.title: Execution of articles of merger
headings.reviewNote: Governs execution of articles of merger in duplicate by nonprofit and business corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes required contents, voting certifications, share conversion terms, and execution standards for articles of merger.

headings.title: Merger with foreign corporations authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes mergers between foreign corporations and domestic nonprofits where permitted by foreign law.

headings.title: Service of process on surviving foreign entity
headings.reviewNote: Deems surviving foreign corporations to have appointed the secretary of state as agent for service of process.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mergers of domestic nonprofit corporations with foreign corporations and establishes service of process rules.

headings.title: Regular course asset transfers and encumbrances

headings.title: Member approval not required for regular dispositions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that member approval is not required for regular course property dispositions or encumbrances.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes boards of directors to dispose of property in the regular course and mortgage corporate assets without member approval.

headings.title: Extraordinary asset dispositions authorized by board
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes property dispositions outside the regular course upon board determination and member authorization.

headings.reviewNote: Requires property dispositions to be approved by boards, members by two-thirds vote, and designated persons.

headings.title: Disposition approval in nonmembership corporations
headings.reviewNote: Governs property disposition approvals by majority board votes in corporations without members.

headings.reviewNote: Requires property disposition solicitations by consent or ballot to include transaction summaries.

headings.title: Abandonment of property disposition transaction

headings.title: Membership purchases by mutual benefit corporations

headings.reviewNote: Authorizes liquidating distributions upon dissolution in conformity with statutory dissolution provisions.

headings.reviewNote: Permits distributions by specialized insurance entities organized under sections 537.620 and 537.635.

headings.title: Dissolution of nonmembership corporations

headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice stating that dissolution will be considered at directors meetings.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs voluntary dissolution of nonmembership corporations by incorporators or directors and adoption of dissolution plans.

headings.title: Approval thresholds for voluntary corporate dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires dissolution to be approved by boards, members by two-thirds vote, and designated persons.

headings.title: Dissolution approval in nonmembership corporations
headings.reviewNote: Governs dissolution approvals by majority board votes in corporations without members.

headings.title: Board and member conditions on dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes boards and members to condition dissolution approvals on higher voting percentages.

headings.title: Notice of member meeting on dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires written meeting notice containing dissolution plans for member consideration.

headings.title: Material soliciting written consents or ballots
headings.reviewNote: Requires solicitations for dissolution by consent or ballot to include copies or summaries of plans.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of plan of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that plans of dissolution specify distribution of remaining assets after creditor payments.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs voluntary dissolution approvals, voting thresholds, meeting notice, and asset distribution plans.

headings.title: Notice of dissolution to attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Requires public benefit corporations to deliver written notice and dissolution plans to the attorney general.

headings.title: Waiting period for asset transfers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transferring assets during dissolution until twenty days after attorney general notice or consent.

headings.title: List of asset recipients delivered
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivering a list of asset transferees and transferred property to the attorney general upon distribution.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes mandatory attorney general notice, transfer waiting periods, and asset recipient reporting for public benefit dissolutions.

headings.title: Delivery and contents of articles of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required statements and voting disclosures in articles of dissolution delivered to the secretary of state.

headings.title: Effective date of corporate dissolution

entries.reviewSummary: Governs contents, member voting disclosures, attorney general notices, and effective dates for articles of dissolution.

headings.title: Effective date of revocation of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that revocation is effective upon the effective date of articles of revocation.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs procedures, authorization standards, articles of revocation, and relation-back effects for revoking corporate dissolution.

headings.title: Corporate existence preserved for winding up
