entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures, written notice rules, deadlines, and claim bars for disposing of known claims against dissolved corporations.

headings.title: Publication of notice of corporate dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissolved corporations to publish notices requesting presentation of claims.

headings.title: Newspaper and legal publication requirements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates publication in county newspapers and statewide legal journals specifying claim details and two-year bar.

headings.title: Barring of published claims after two years
headings.reviewNote: Bars unknown, unacted, or contingent claims unless enforcement proceedings begin within two years of publication.

headings.title: Enforcement of claims against assets or shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Limits claim enforcement to undistributed assets or pro rata distributions received by shareholders.

headings.title: Standard for establishing fraudulent intent
headings.reviewNote: Defines fraudulent intent as showing the sole or primary purpose was defrauding shareholders or creditors.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs newspaper and legal journal notice publication, two-year claim bars, and asset recovery rules for unknown claims.

headings.title: Exemption for insured indemnity claims
headings.reviewNote: Exempts insured corporate claims from statutory bars and authorizes appointment of defendants ad litem.

headings.title: Enforceability limited to insurance proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Restricts enforcement of judgments obtained under insured claims solely against applicable insurance policies.

entries.reviewSummary: Exempts insured indemnity claims from corporate dissolution claim bars and limits judgment recoveries to insurance proceeds.

headings.title: Filing and contents of articles of termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing articles of termination stating that all claims and corporate debts have been discharged.

headings.title: Filing fee for articles of termination
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a statutory five dollar fee for filing articles of termination.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of termination and effect
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of certificates of termination, extinguishing corporate existence and releasing corporate names.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs filing, contents, fees, and legal effect of articles of termination following full liquidation of claims and debts.

headings.title: Notice of grounds for administrative dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires the secretary of state to serve written notice of grounds for administrative dissolution.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of administrative dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Permits issuing and serving a dissolution certificate if grounds remain uncured after at least sixty days, and requires written notice to the attorney general for public benefit corporations.

headings.title: Winding up activities of dissolved corporation
headings.reviewNote: Restricts activities of administratively dissolved corporations strictly to winding up and notifying claimants.

headings.title: Authority of registered agent unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Maintains the authority of registered agents following administrative corporate dissolution.

headings.title: Reservation period for corporate name
headings.reviewNote: Protects corporate names from use by others for two years following administrative dissolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates procedures, sixty-day cure periods, winding-up limitations, and name protections for administrative dissolution.

headings.title: Application for reinstatement after dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes contents of applications for reinstatement following administrative dissolution or forfeiture.

headings.title: Cancellation of dissolution and certificate of reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Directs cancellation of dissolution and issuance of reinstatement certificates upon compliant applications.

headings.title: Relation back and retroactive validation of actions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that reinstatement relates back to the dissolution date and validates interim corporate activities.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs application requirements, tax clearances, certificates, and retroactive relation-back effects for corporate reinstatement.

headings.title: Notice of denial of corporate reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice explaining reasons upon denial of reinstatement by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Judicial appeal to Cole County circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appeals by petition to the Cole County circuit court within ninety days of denial notice.

headings.title: Summary judicial order for reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit courts to order reinstatement summarily or grant other appropriate relief.

headings.title: Appellate review of judicial decision
headings.reviewNote: Provides that final circuit court decisions may be appealed as in other civil proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures, Cole County venue, ninety-day deadlines, and appellate rights for appealing reinstatement denials.

headings.title: Grounds for judicial dissolution of corporation
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates grounds for circuit court dissolution in proceedings by the attorney general, qualifying members, directors or designated persons, creditors, or the corporation.

headings.title: Mandatory judicial considerations prior to dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Directs courts to consider reasonable alternatives, public interest, and member protections before dissolving.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes substantive grounds and mandatory equitable considerations for judicial dissolution of nonprofit corporations.

headings.title: Venue for judicial dissolution proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Cole County venue for attorney general suits and principal office venue for other parties.

headings.title: Parties defendant to judicial dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that directors and members need not be joined as parties unless individual relief is sought.

headings.title: Injunctive relief and receivers pendente lite
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes injunctions, appointments of receivers or custodians pendente lite, and asset preservation orders.

headings.title: Notice to attorney general and intervention
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to the attorney general for public benefit involuntary dissolution proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates venue, party joinder, interim receiverships, injunctions, and attorney general notice for judicial dissolutions.

headings.title: Judicial appointment of receivers or custodians
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit courts to appoint receivers or custodians in nonprofit dissolution proceedings.

headings.title: Eligible entities and receiver bond requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointment of individuals or corporations and permits requiring surety bonds.

headings.title: Powers and duties of receivers and custodians
headings.reviewNote: Empowers receivers to sell assets and sue, and custodians to manage corporate affairs.

headings.title: Redesignation between receiver and custodian
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to redesignate receivers as custodians or custodians as receivers.

headings.title: Compensation and expense reimbursements from assets
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court to order compensation and expense disbursements or reimbursements paid to receivers, custodians, and their counsel from corporate assets or sale proceeds.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs appointment, qualifications, bonds, powers, redesignation, and compensation of receivers and custodians.

headings.title: Entry and filing of dissolution decree
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit courts to enter dissolution decrees and directs filing certified copies with the state.

headings.title: Court direction of winding up and liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Directs courts to oversee corporate winding up, asset liquidation, and claimant notices.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs entry, secretary of state filing, and judicial supervision of winding up under decrees of dissolution.

headings.title: Certificate of authority required for foreign corporations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits foreign nonprofit corporations from transacting business without obtaining certificates of authority.

headings.title: Activities not constituting transacting business
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates activities exempt from foreign registration, including litigation, meetings, and bank accounts.

headings.title: Nonexhaustive nature of statutory exclusion list
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the statutory list of activities not constituting transacting business is nonexhaustive.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires foreign corporations to obtain certificates of authority and enumerates non-transactional business activities.

headings.title: Bar on maintaining legal proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Precludes unauthorized foreign corporations from maintaining court proceedings in Missouri.

headings.title: Bar applicable to corporate successors and assignees
headings.reviewNote: Extends legal proceeding bars to successors and assignees of unauthorized foreign corporations.

headings.title: Judicial stay of proceedings pending compliance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to stay proceedings until foreign corporations obtain required certificates.

headings.title: Civil penalties for transacting business without authority
headings.reviewNote: Imposes daily civil penalties up to two thousand dollars annually, collectible by the attorney general.

headings.title: Validity of corporate acts and defense rights
headings.reviewNote: Preserves validity of corporate contracts and permits foreign corporations to defend proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes consequences of transacting business without authority, including court access bars, civil penalties, and defense rights.

headings.title: Application contents for certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required disclosures in foreign corporation applications delivered to the secretary of state.

headings.title: Authenticated certificate of existence required
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign applicants to deliver authenticated certificates of existence from home jurisdictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes application contents and authenticated certificate of existence requirements for foreign corporate authority.

headings.title: Grounds requiring amended certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires amended certificates upon changes in corporate name, duration, or jurisdiction of incorporation.

headings.title: Application standards for amended certificates
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory original certificate requirements to applications for amended certificates of authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mandatory triggers and application procedures for obtaining amended foreign certificates of authority.

headings.title: Scope of authority under certificate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes foreign corporations to transact business in the state subject to revocation.

headings.title: Equal rights and liabilities with domestic corporations
headings.reviewNote: Grants foreign corporations equal rights, privileges, duties, and liabilities as domestic nonprofits.

headings.title: Nonregulation of foreign internal affairs
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits state regulation of the organization or internal governance of foreign corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines rights, equal standing with domestic nonprofits, and internal affair protections for authorized foreign corporations.

headings.title: Fictitious name adoption by foreign corporation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes foreign corporations to adopt board-certified fictitious names when legal names are unavailable.

headings.title: Distinguishability standard for foreign corporate names
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign corporate names to be distinguishable upon secretary of state records.

headings.title: Permissible use of another corporate name
headings.reviewNote: Permits using names of existing entities upon merger, reorganization, or asset acquisitions.

headings.title: Ineligibility under nonconforming changed names
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transacting business under nonconforming changed names without adopting compliant names.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates corporate name distinguishability, fictitious names, and merger exceptions for foreign nonprofit corporations.

headings.title: Statement of change of foreign office or agent
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required disclosures in foreign corporate statements changing registered offices or agents.

headings.title: Agent change of business office address
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered agents to change registered office addresses across represented foreign corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs corporate and agent statements of change for foreign registered offices and registered agents.

headings.title: Statement of resignation of foreign registered agent
headings.reviewNote: Permits a foreign corporation's registered agent to resign by delivering the original and two exact or conformed copies of a statement of resignation, which may discontinue the registered office.

headings.title: Secretary of state mailing of resignation copy
headings.reviewNote: Directs the secretary of state to mail copies of resignation statements to corporate officers.

headings.title: Effective date of agency termination
headings.reviewNote: Terminates registered agency appointments on the thirtieth day after filing statements of resignation.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates resignation procedures, notice mailings, and thirty-day effective termination dates for foreign registered agents.

headings.title: Registered agent service on foreign corporation
headings.reviewNote: Designates registered agents as corporate agents for service of process, notice, or demand.

headings.title: Service by mail on foreign corporation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered or certified mail service upon corporate secretaries under specified conditions.

headings.title: Perfection of mail service on foreign corporation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes when service by mail is perfected based on receipt or mailing elapsed days.

headings.title: Other lawful service methods preserved
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory foreign service provisions do not prescribe exclusive service methods.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs service of process on foreign corporations through registered agents, substituted mail service, and nonexclusive remedies.

headings.title: Certificate of withdrawal required
headings.reviewNote: Requires authorized foreign corporations to obtain certificates of withdrawal before withdrawing.

headings.title: Application contents for certificate of withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required statements, agent revocations, and mailing commitments in withdrawal applications.

headings.title: Substituted service on secretary after withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service on the secretary of state after withdrawal and mandates mailing to corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs application requirements, agent revocations, and substituted service of process for foreign corporate withdrawals.

headings.title: Administrative grounds for revoking certificate
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates report defaults, fee nonpayment, agent absence, fraud, and dissolution grounds for revocation.

headings.title: Attorney general grounds for revoking certificate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes attorney general revocation proceedings for authority abuse, asset waste, or inability to function.

entries.reviewSummary: Specifies administrative and attorney general grounds for revoking foreign corporate certificates of authority.

headings.title: Notice of administrative grounds for revocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the secretary of state to serve written notice of administrative revocation determinations.

headings.title: Notice of attorney general revocation grounds
headings.reviewNote: Requires the secretary of state to serve written notice upon attorney general revocation determinations.

headings.title: Certificate of revocation after sixty days
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuance and service of revocation certificates if grounds remain uncured after sixty days.

headings.title: Cessation of authority to transact business
headings.reviewNote: Terminates foreign corporate authority to transact business on the effective date of revocation.

headings.title: Service on secretary of state after revocation
headings.reviewNote: Appoints the secretary of state as service agent for causes of action arising during authorization.

headings.title: Authority of registered agent unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Maintains the authority of foreign registered agents following certificate revocation.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs notice procedures, cure periods, certificates of revocation, and post-revocation service of process.

headings.title: Judicial appeal from certificate revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court appeals within thirty days of revocation certificate service.

headings.title: Summary judicial order for reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit courts to order reinstatement summarily or grant other appropriate relief.

headings.title: Appellate review of judicial decision
headings.reviewNote: Provides that final circuit court revocation decisions may be appealed as in other civil proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures, thirty-day deadlines, and appellate rights for foreign corporate appeals of certificate revocations.

headings.title: Mandatory corporate minutes and action records
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to maintain permanent minutes and records of actions taken without meetings.

headings.title: Maintenance of appropriate accounting records
headings.reviewNote: Mandates maintenance of appropriate corporate accounting and financial records.

headings.title: Record of members and voting entitlements
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining alphabetical membership records showing member addresses and voting allocations.

headings.title: Form and accessibility of corporate records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes maintaining records in written or electronically convertible formats.

headings.title: Records maintained at principal office
headings.reviewNote: Specifies essential articles, bylaws, member resolutions, three-year minutes and communications, officer lists, registration reports, and financial statements kept at principal offices, exempting public benefit donor and art-transaction disclosures.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates corporate recordkeeping requirements, accounting standards, membership lists, and principal office document retention.

headings.title: Member and resident right to inspect
headings.reviewNote: Entitles members and qualifying paying residents to inspect and copy required records upon at least five business days' written notice or demand.

headings.title: Inspection of permanent records and financials
headings.reviewNote: Entitles members and qualifying paying residents to inspect and copy section 355.821(1) permanent records and corporate financial statements upon at least five business days' written notice.

headings.title: Proper purpose requirement for inspection
headings.reviewNote: Requires demands to describe purpose and requested records with particularity.

headings.title: Litigation discovery and court powers unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Preserves independent litigation discovery rights and judicial powers to compel record production.

headings.title: Religious corporation inspection limitations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes church corporations to limit member inspection rights while protecting paying residents.

headings.title: Inspection rights in nonmembership corporations
headings.reviewNote: Extends member inspection rights to service recipients and beneficiaries in nonmembership corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs member and resident rights to inspect corporate books, records, and financial statements, setting purpose standards.

headings.title: Inspection rights of agents and attorneys
headings.reviewNote: Extends inspection and copying rights to authorized agents and attorneys of members or residents.

headings.title: Right to receive copies of records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes receiving photographic or electrostatic copies of requested corporate records.

headings.title: Reasonable copying charges permitted
headings.reviewNote: Permits corporations to charge reasonable fees covering actual labor and material costs of reproduction.

headings.title: Compliance by providing compiled membership list
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes satisfying membership inspection demands by providing freshly compiled member lists.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines the scope of member inspection rights, agent representation, copying methods, reproduction charges, and member list delivery.

headings.title: Court order for principal office records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes summary circuit court orders for inspection of principal office records at corporate expense.

headings.title: Court order for other corporate records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes expedited circuit court proceedings to permit inspection of other corporate records.

headings.title: Award of member costs and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires ordering the corporation to pay the member's or resident's costs and reasonable counsel fees unless the corporation proves it refused inspection for good cause.

headings.title: Reasonable restrictions on record use
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to impose reasonable restrictions on the use or distribution of inspected records.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs circuit court proceedings to compel inspection of corporate records, fee shifting, and protective orders.

headings.title: Duty to furnish annual financial statements
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations (except as provided in church corporation articles or bylaws) to furnish latest annual financial statements upon written demand from a member or resident.

headings.title: Accompanying accountant report or officer statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires certified public accountant reports or officer statements regarding accounting bases.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires corporations to furnish annual financial statements to members and specifies required accountant or officer certifications.

headings.title: Corporate registration report contents
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required disclosures regarding corporate names, registered agents, and director addresses.

headings.title: Currency of reported information
headings.reviewNote: Requires information in registration reports to be current on the date of execution.

headings.title: Annual filing deadlines and late fees
headings.reviewNote: Establishes August thirty-first filing deadlines, late fees, and administrative dissolution for nonfiling.

headings.title: Correction of nonconforming registration reports
headings.reviewNote: Directs the secretary of state to notify corporations and return nonconforming reports for correction.

headings.title: Change of agent or office with report
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes changing registered offices or agents within annual registration reports with agent consents.

headings.title: Prescribed format and medium for report
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate registration reports to be filed in formats and media prescribed by the secretary.

headings.title: Signature and truthfulness representation
headings.reviewNote: Requires authorized signatures representing truthfulness subject to statutory false statement penalties.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs filing deadlines, required contents, late penalties, agent changes, and signature verifications for corporate registration reports.

headings.title: Option of biennial corporate registration reports
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes biennial registration reports based on odd or even year incorporation dates with technology fees.

headings.title: Twenty-four month registration cycle rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining biennial registration for full twenty-four month periods before returning to annual cycles.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for biennial registration
headings.reviewNote: Permits the secretary of state to promulgate administration rules subject to chapter 536 and section 536.028 compliance and nonseverability for rules after August 28, 2009.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes biennial corporate registration options, fee schedules, filing cycles, and administrative rulemaking.

headings.title: Savings clause for repealed statutory provisions
headings.reviewNote: Preserves prior rights, liabilities, proceedings, reorganizations, and meetings from impairment by statutory repeal.

headings.title: Preservation of corporate reinstatement provisions
headings.reviewNote: Affirms that repeals and reenactments do not void or invalidate administrative reinstatement rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes a comprehensive savings clause preserving preexisting corporate rights, liabilities, and reinstatement authorities upon statutory repeal.
